title: How do I add a new translation language?
intent: This article explains how to add a new language translation to a survey.
short_answer: To add a new language, navigate to the Translations page and use the 'Add New Translation' option. Select the target language from the dropdown. A new empty translation is created that you can then fill in online or import from a file.
procedure: Select the target language from the dropdown list.
The new (empty) translation appears in the translations table.
Fill in translations for all labels or import a translation file.
important_conditions: New translations are created as inactive and incomplete.
All labels must be translated before a translation can be activated.
The language must not already exist as a translation for this survey.
troubleshooting: 'Please select a language to add': Select a valid language code from the dropdown.
Language already exists: Each language can only be added once per survey.
